turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I keep dying at the same boss and I'm about to give up.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Frustrating. Do you want some tips on beating it, or would you rather turn the difficulty down and enjoy the story?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold on, I need to talk to my roommate for a second. Stay quiet until I say I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hannah, look at the fish tank. Does the water look cloudy to you?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: A little, yeah. When did you last change it?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Maybe three weeks ago? I kind of lost track.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: That's probably it. Do a partial change this weekend and go easy on the food.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Do you still have that siphon thing?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It's under my sink, I'll bring it over.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm back, sorry for the wait.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. Decided how to handle that boss yet?
